body:
String lowers to LLVM's opaque ptr type; a literal becomes a real, private, hex-escaped, NUL-terminated global constant, referenced directly by its own name (no getelementptr decay under opaque pointers). Refactored sigs/sig_count into one shared LlvmModule struct. Verified live against real llc 18: compiled a quote/backslash/newline-containing string end to end, confirmed correct bytes in the object file. 9 more real assertions (31 total). make test: 347/347; editor-demo, clang route, and direct-AVR route all still build clean.

⚓ ☃
title: LLVM backend: real String support added
